product_mix.note: Nine of 30 ads sell phone cases and Stack add-ons, six sell the Loop power bank, five sell bags, four sell desk organisers, three mix gifts, two sell artist cases and one launches Node; no ad shows or states a price.

series.name: Pivot studio pack-ups
series.note: Two silent studio films of a person packing a named backpack, with one ad-text line, run 125 and 91 days; a creator ad for the same range shares their landing page.

series.name: iPhone 18 case set
series.note: Six ads link to the iPhone 18 collection, two silent brand films (70 days) and four creator-style ads (19 to 57 days), started 2026-09-14 to 2026-11-04.

series.name: Loop power banks
series.note: Six ads for one power bank, from a creator test to a silent climbing film; started 2026-09-30 to 2026-11-05, with sizes and certification wording that vary between them.

series.name: Array desk organiser
series.note: Three films for one organiser (two silent unboxings, one voiceover) plus a desk build that also uses it; started 2026-10-16 to 2026-11-13.

series.name: Silent films
series.note: Fifteen of 30 ads have no speech and rely on on-screen text or ad text, including the five oldest ads.

series.name: Creator-style ad text
series.note: Thirteen ads tag the brand handle in the ad text and six carry a paid-partnership tag; no creator name or handle appears on screen.

contradictions.text: Loop capacity and wording differ: three sizes from 5,000 to 20,000 mAh and 'true MagSafe' in one ad, '10000 mAh' printed on the unit and 'Qi2-certified' in the ad text of others, and '20,000' by voice in a bag reveal.
The phone model changes between speech and link: iPhone 17 Pro said over an iPhone 18 collection page, and iPhone 18 Pro said over a link that says iPhone 18.
One discount code appears in two ads for two different products and neither states what it takes off.
A Loop monologue spends about half its script on Stack while its ad text and link name only the Loop.
The Node launch text says 'Power that moves when you do' over a film that shows no battery, charger or phone.
Claims with nothing on screen to back them: design awards for Stack, seven expressions and a 70 year-old artist, and 'our biggest case collection yet' over six named colours.
